lines: Special Week: Hmmm... What song should I pick for my singing lessons...|Special Week: The teacher said it's fine to just pick a song I like, but I don't know any popular songs...|Special Week: Songs I like, huh... What about "LOVE & TURF"? Mom used to sing it all the time.|Special Week: She said Mama really liked it too... All right, I'll do that song!

Special Week: Tracen Academy sure is big!|Special Week: It reminds me of... the open fields back home.|Special Week: Jogging through those fields was the best... Makes me want to run!|Special Week: Wait, no, I can't! Mustn't run in the halls... Running in the halls is bad...

Special Week: That cheese my mom sent sure was tasty...|Special Week: It was so rich... Really gave me a craving for some fresh milk straight from the cow...|Special Week: Ah, that's it! Trainer, what if we raised dairy cows on campus?|Special Week: We could use the cow pies as fertilizer for the fields too! And while we're at it, why don't we raise some chickens and pigs—|Special Week: Ah, wait, then I guess it'd be more of a farm than a school, huh...|Special Week: Awww... I thought I had a pretty good thing going there...

Special Week: There are so many Umamusume here... It still feels weird to me.|Silence Suzuka: You were the only Umamusume living in your hometown, right?|Special Week: Right. That's probably why I get a little nervous around the others occasionally...|Special Week: But I made a promise to my mom, so I've gotta make lots and lots of friends here!|Silence Suzuka: Hehe, I'm sure you'll do just that.|Special Week: Once I make a hundred friends, I wanna have a huuuge picnic with everyone! ♪|Special Week: When that happens, let's eat lots and lots of carrot sandwiches!|Silence Suzuka: Okay, I can't wait.

Tokai Teio: Spe, Spe! I heard you're having trouble with your homework.|Special Week: I aaaam! Why does math have to be so hard...|Tokai Teio: Well, why didn't you say something sooner? The genius Teio will help you study! ♪|Special Week: Wow, really?! Well, then by all mea—|Special Week: Huh? Wait, Teio... Aren't you a year below me?|Tokai Teio: Hm? Am I? Well, I'm super smart, so it doesn't matter! ♪|Special Week: Wow, thanks, Teio! Then please, share your math knowledge with me!|Tokai Teio: Ehehehe! You've got it!

Special Week: You guys, you guys! Tomorrow the crepe place is going to be half off! We should go!|El Condor Pasa: Great idea! I'll obviously have the El Special!|Grass Wonder: El Special? Is that what you ordered last time?|El Condor Pasa: Claro! It's an egg and sausage crepe with lots and LOTS of hot sauce! The perfect crepe for me! ♪|Special Week: I think I'll get the vanilla ice cream crepe made with real Hokkaido milk! ♪ How about you, Grass?|Grass Wonder: I suppose I'll get the red bean and matcha syrup crepe. I just love how subtle the sweetness is...|Special Week: Japanese-style crepes do sound good! ♪ All right, I can't wait until tomorrow!|Grass Wonder: Well, then you'd better get studying... Failing tomorrow's quiz will result in extra lessons, and that means no crepes.|Special Week: Okay...|El Condor Pasa: Yes, ma'am...

Silence Suzuka: Huff... I can't... I should stop here...|Silence Suzuka: But I... I love it so much... It's calling me back already...|Silence Suzuka: The turf!|Silence Suzuka: ...Okay, a short break, and then one more lap. That shouldn't count as overworking myself... right?

Silence Suzuka: This morning, I had my fortune told by  Fukukitaru.|Silence Suzuka: She said taiyaki would lead me to the one who will show me the greatest scenery...|Silence Suzuka: But I haven't run into anybody so far... Am I supposed to be doing something special?|Silence Suzuka: Like... Feeding anyone who looks like the right person?

Silence Suzuka: Phew... Delicious.|Silence Suzuka: Trainer, do you happen to know this drink's slogan?|Silence Suzuka: "Beyond the clearest vista."|Silence Suzuka: That phrase really stuck with me as a child. Now I feel nostalgic whenever I have this drink.|Silence Suzuka: Hehe... Maybe I should get one more.

Taiki Shuttle: Suzuka! It happened again! I found more crop circles!|Silence Suzuka: R-really? Are you sure you're not just—|Taiki Shuttle: I swear I wasn't imaginin' things! Cross my heart!|Taiki Shuttle: It was by the riverbank and in the tall grass by the park! There were these swirly-lookin' circles in the grass!|Silence Suzuka: Huh? But I was training in both of those areas recently...|Taiki Shuttle: Oho? Does that mean you're callin' the UFOs here?|Silence Suzuka: Hehehe, of course not. That's just—|Silence Suzuka: (Wait... I trained in the last place she found circles in too. Does that... mean...)|Silence Suzuka: N-no way... Am I really... summoning aliens?|Taiki Shuttle: Only one way to find out! Let's go train on the roof! ☆

Silence Suzuka: I see the student council is busy as always. I hope you're faring well, Air—um, I mean Ms. Air Groove.|Air Groove: ...Why are you talking like that? Is something wrong?|Silence Suzuka: Spe is always so polite around you, so I thought I should do the same...|Air Groove: So that's it... Well, not that I mind formal language in general...|Air Groove: But you and I are far too close for that, no? I see no point in keeping each other at arm's length.|Silence Suzuka: Hehe, true.|Silence Suzuka: Then I won't hold back in my speech... or our races.|Air Groove: ...!|Air Groove: Heh, that's what I like to hear.|Silence Suzuka: Ehehe.

Tokai Teio: Hey, listen to this, Trainerrr!|Tokai Teio: Mayano said I'm still a stupid kid 'cause I don't know anything about love!|Tokai Teio: But that's not true! I know a thing or two about it, I swear!|Tokai Teio: I mean, your chest gets all tight and your heart goes crazy, right? That's just like what happens when I watch a super amazing race!|Tokai Teio: Hey! What're you laughing at?! If I'm wrong, just tell me!

Tokai Teio: Greetings, dear Trainer! How farest thou?|Tokai Teio: Me? Why, I'm simply speaking like a true monarch of the turf should. ♪|Tokai Teio: Pretty cool, doncha thin—I mean, magnificent, don't you agree?|Tokai Teio: Urgh... This is harder than I thought!

Tokai Teio: Now let's see... Where could everyone be hiding this time?|Tokai Teio: Mayano and Marvelous seem like they'd get tired of waiting to be found, sooo...|Tokai Teio: I bet they're hiding in places where they can distract themselves, like the school store or the cafe!|Tokai Teio: All right! I'll show you both just how great Tokai Teio is! Ready or not, here I come! ♪

Tokai Teio: Is Air Groove seriously still talking with the teacher?|Tokai Teio: Look at my poor tail and ears... Even they're bored out of their minds!|Symboli Rudolf: Is that so? I don't think that much time has passed.|Tokai Teio: You're just too patient, Prez! And why are you suddenly so free anyway? You're always busy!|Symboli Rudolf: I simply have no pressing matters that need my attention. I thought this would be a good time to stretch my legs, so to speak.|Symboli Rudolf: Besides, it's not often that I have time to chat with you, so I'd like it to last a while.|Tokai Teio: R-really?|Tokai Teio: Ehehe! ♪ Well, if that's what you want, I suppose I can stick around a liiittle longer!|Tokai Teio: So whatcha wanna talk about? The day we first met?|Symboli Rudolf: Whatever you please. I simply wish to hear you speak with joy in your voice.

Tokai Teio: Hey, McQueen! Wanna play baseball together?|Tokai Teio: You go to games pretty regularly, right? I need a teammate, so I figured you'd be the one to ask!|Mejiro McQueen: H-how did you—|Tokai Teio: I happened to hear you talking to Golshi, that's all! ♪ A fan like you must've played a game or two, right?|Mejiro McQueen: Urgh... Well, you're not exactly wrong...|Tokai Teio: Then let's play! That should be just as fun as watching, right?|Tokai Teio: Especially when you hit the ball! The sound of the metal bat colliding with the ball is the best! ♪|Mejiro McQueen: W-well... I suppose you leave me with no choice but to—|Tokai Teio: Yippee! We needed an umpire to play, so this is perfect!|Mejiro McQueen: Umpire?! Now hold on! The umpire doesn't get to hit the ball at all!

Maruzensky: Awww, turned down again. What's everybody so shy for?|Maruzensky: Ah, perfect timing!|Maruzensky: How'd you like to go on a date with little ol' me?|Maruzensky: We'll go for a drive along the beach! I'll be sure to leave your heart pounding. ☆

Maruzensky: Ugh...Talk about bogus. Why didn't I clean my place sooner?|Maruzensky: Living on your own means you can easily put off cleaning for another day.|Maruzensky: But that's the problem! My juniors are coming over tomorrow! I need to clean!|Maruzensky: I know! I'll just put everything on the floor into the closet! Problem solved!

Maruzensky: Kids these days put pictures of their food on the world wide web, right?|Maruzensky: Well, have I got the perfect dishes for that! Everyone on Umastagram will be sooo jelly!|Maruzensky: You wanna know? Tiramisu and nata de coco! Serve 'em with Italian food, and you've got the hottest spread around!|Maruzensky: I'm sure you'll get lots of "Looks" with that combo!

Maruzensky: Hey, Rudolf. You know, our uniform's cute and all...|Maruzensky: But I get the feeling that a liiittle tweaking would make everyone feel even more powerful!|Symboli Rudolf: Uniforms are not something that can be changed on a whim, but... Let's hear it.|Maruzensky: Far out! Lemme give you the skinny. ☆|Maruzensky: There's an item that, when put in clothes, makes you appear super dignified and waaay cooler instantly!|Maruzensky: And that is... shoulder pads!|Symboli Rudolf: Shoulder pads... I believe I've heard of them. The fact that they can change your silhouette so drastically is indeed interesting.|Maruzensky: I know, right? Strong shoulders are the sign of a strong person. ☆|Maruzensky: Everyone will look super fresh with their new, bold shoulders!|Symboli Rudolf: Hm... Perhaps I will bring this up in the next student council meeting.

Grass Wonder: Thank you for treating me, Maruzen.|Maruzensky: No problemo! Think of it as payback for going for a drive with me! ☆|Maruzensky: Sooo, how've things been since? Everything chill?|Grass Wonder: Hehe, yes. The irritation I felt up until now has been blown away, carried off by the wind.|Maruzensky: Hehe, well, that's good!|Maruzensky: ...You know, I've thought this before, but you and I are really similar.|Maruzensky: Which is why... you should come to me when you're troubled. We'll go for a drive and blow your problems away! ♪|Grass Wonder: Hehe, all right, but...|Grass Wonder: I don't want everything to be about me every time, so how about I invite you to tea next time?|Maruzensky: I getcha! Sounds groovy to me, baby! I'll drink your tea any day of the week. ☆

Smart Falcon: You know, to make it as an Umadol, it's extra important to keep up with the latest trends! ♪|Ines Fujin: I don't really know much about Umadols, but I think that's a great point!|Maruzensky: Then first things first—folding fans! The flashier and fluffier they are, the more attention you'll grab. ♪|Ines Fujin: Fluffy folding fans? I don't think I've ever seen those...|Smart Falcon: Flashy and super fluffy? Oooh! Sounds great—perfect for an Umadol! ☆|Maruzensky: Pair that with a glittering bodycon dress and you'll be super fly! ♪|Ines Fujin: Bodycon? I've never heard that either...|Maruzensky: With that settled, let's go get changed! We've got to jet while the iron's hot! ♪|Smart Falcon: All right, let's do iiit! ☆ Woo! Umadols, gooo!|Ines Fujin: Hey, wait a minute! I'm pretty sure none of those are the latest trends!

Fuji Kiseki: What's this? "A blinding light, the stage of miracles..." As radiant as ever, I see...|Fuji Kiseki: But I shall not be overshadowed!|Fuji Kiseki: I swore I would give the crowd the show of a lifetime. And I intend to keep that promise.|Fuji Kiseki: I'm no longer that little girl watching you go. I'm forging my own path now... Mother.

Fuji Kiseki: Oh dear, someone looks tired.|Fuji Kiseki: I just hate to see you like this... I like you best when you're smiling...|Fuji Kiseki: Eeend scene. ♪|Fuji Kiseki: I found that line in one of the romance manga my juniors are so enamored with these days. How did I do?|Fuji Kiseki: I do apologize for the scare. But I can assure you that it wasn't a lie.|Fuji Kiseki: After all, I would love nothing more than for you to be happy and full of life.

Fuji Kiseki: Hmmm... Could we perhaps cut our meeting a little short today?|Fuji Kiseki: One of my juniors seeks my advice, and I also need to help the dorm keeper with something. After that, there's the study session I need to—|Fuji Kiseki: Ah... Apologies. As you can see, I'm quite the busy bee.|Fuji Kiseki: Um... Please don't look at me like that. I assure you I'm not overworking myself. I swear!|Fuji Kiseki: ...All right, I shall adjust my schedule. I certainly don't wish to worry you any further.

Fuji Kiseki: Hm... Mhm.|Hishi Amazon: What the? The heck're you staring at?!|Fuji Kiseki: It's nothing. I just find it so amusing that everyone treats you like their big sister.|Fuji Kiseki: I'd like to try it myself sometime... What if I called you... Big Sis?|Hishi Amazon: I'm not your Big Sis! Besides, you'd never use something so plain...|Hishi Amazon: Knowing you, you'd go with something flowery like "Dearest Sister," or—|Fuji Kiseki: Oh my!|Fuji Kiseki: To think you would call me that... I must say, I'm delighted!|Hishi Amazon: What?! Th-that was just an example! Forget you ever heard it!|Fuji Kiseki: Ahaha! I believe that will be rather difficult, Big Sis. ♪|Hishi Amazon: Fuuuuujjjiiiii!

Fuji Kiseki: You see, I'm currently on the hunt for a new trick to dazzle the audience with.|Agnes Tachyon: Oho? Then allow me to be of assistance! I just happen to have a new serum I've been meaning to—|Fuji Kiseki: Now, now, Tachyon. What did I say about experimenting on others?|Fuji Kiseki: I would appreciate your help, though. Your research is very intriguing to me, after all.|Agnes Tachyon: Hmph... Fine, have it your way. But what is it you want from me, then?|Fuji Kiseki: Well... I know! Can you make flowers sparkle like lights?|Fuji Kiseki: I want to see those glistening flowers rain down from the sky, leaving the audience stunned and overjoyed!|Agnes Tachyon: If it's flowers you want, I recently acquired some rafflesia for my genetics research.|Agnes Tachyon: Perhaps I could install some lights into their centers and drop them on the crowd from the rafters.|Fuji Kiseki: U-ummm... That certainly would be stunning, but in a much more... pungent way.

Oguri Cap: Hrm... The bell rang before I could finish my test again.|Oguri Cap: If I was a quick thinker like Tama, would my scores go up? Just like... Tama...|Oguri Cap: Whatcha talkin' 'bout?|Oguri Cap: Yup, that's her, all right.

Oguri Cap: I wonder what Tome and the other folks from back home are doing right now...|Oguri Cap: It'd be nice if I could give them some good news soon.|Oguri Cap: Trainer, do you ever miss your hometown?|Oguri Cap: If you do, please let me know.|Oguri Cap: I will be your Tome!

Oguri Cap: This school is filled with nothing but the best of the best Umamusume...|Oguri Cap: It makes my heart skip a beat. But I'm not scared... I'm excited.|Oguri Cap: Racing everyone here is so much fun, even more fun than back in Kasamatsu.|Oguri Cap: Watch me, Trainer. I swear... I will win!

Bamboo Memory: Oguri, I challenge you! You and me, on the racecourse!|Oguri Cap: Sure thing. But...|Oguri Cap: Can it wait till after I finish this pork bun? After all...|Oguri Cap: Pork buns should be eaten when they're still hot!|Bamboo Memory: What are you saying?! Why...|Bamboo Memory: Of course you should finish that first! Now hurry up and eat it!|Oguri Cap: Heh... You got it!

Oguri Cap: ...|Tamamo Cross: That freshly steamed rice and grilled salmon sure hit the spot...|Oguri Cap: Huh?! D-did I say that out loud?|Tamamo Cross: Nah, just a good guess. I figured you'd be thinkin' 'bout food.|Oguri Cap: That's amazing, Tama! You're like a real-life fortune teller!|Tamamo Cross: Yep, yep, it's always been a dream of mine... Nooot!

Gold Ship: Saturn is exactly eighty light-minutes away from this very spot... Assuming a ten-centimeter diameter, that's the equivalent of lining up 140 million donuts.|Gold Ship: Easy-peasy! If I go all out, I can make that distance in two days!|Gold Ship: YOU! Get ready for lift off! Prepare the  emergency donuts!|Gold Ship: After all, when the going gets tough, the tough need donuts...

Gold Ship: If you ask me, there are two kinds of people in this world.|Gold Ship: Those who know when to swallow dried squid... and those who don't.|Gold Ship: If I'm being honest, I am the latter... No matter how much I chew, it just never feels right.|Gold Ship: Oh, a sympathetic face, I see.|Gold Ship: Then let us undertake this journey together... A journey to jaws strong enough to bite through even the Kraken itself!

Gold Ship: Step right up! Get your iced hot water here!|Gold Ship: Bubbling hot water, cooled with only the iciest of ice...|Gold Ship: In other words, tepid water!|Gold Ship: Room temperature? More like right temperature! Not too cold, but not too hot! Get 'em while they're lukewarm!

Gold Ship: Look who's got her nose in a book. Whatcha reading, Big Mack?|Mejiro McQueen: Umamusume Athletics through Physics. I thought it might prove useful to my training.|Gold Ship: Ah, Upon Achilles Shield Lies a Kebab, eh... A great mystery novel if I say so myself.|Gold Ship: To think the kebab stand owner would be the culprit... I had the Turkish ice cream salesman pegged for the villain.|Mejiro McQueen: No, the book I'm reading is called Umamusume Athletics through Physics. It's—|Gold Ship: Oh, Under the Overpass at Three in the Morning, right? Yeah, that's one heck of an anthem. Really speaks to the problems with society.|Gold Ship: Really makes you think... Is the world corrupt, or is it just me? Deep stuff.|Mejiro McQueen: No, like I said, it's called Umamusume Athletics through Physics!|Gold Ship: A Modern Relic: Java Man, huh? Yeah, old-fashioned values just don't cut it in the modern era, do they... That essay really gets to the core of the issue.|Mejiro McQueen: Oooh, that does it! Are you trying to have a conversation or not?!

Gold Ship: Hic... So good! Thank you for giving up your freedom, oh delicious fishies!|Tosen Jordan: Uh... Why're you crying?|Gold Ship: Why wouldn't I be?! I must show my gratitude to the great sea bream!|Gold Ship: Every day they lay themselves down on a hot iron plate, never moving a muscle!|Gold Ship: There they lie, sacrificing their lives for us... Obviously we should show gratitude when consuming them!|Tosen Jordan: Wait, I thought taiyaki were just shaped like fish... You're telling me they're real?!|Tosen Jordan: Wow... talk about cringe. I legit just figured that out.|Gold Ship: We can't let their sacrifices be in vain! Now, promise you will appreciate the flavor of taiyaki!|Gold Ship: Thank you, taiyaki! May your flavor continue to satisfy me for eons to come!|Tosen Jordan: Yeah, you're the real GOAT here, taiyaki! We stan!

Vodka: Raaaaagh!|Vodka: DAMMIT! I can't get that stupid k-k-kiss scene from the movie out of my head!|Vodka: Come ooon, nerves of steel! Nerves of steel. Nerves of steel. Nerves of steel!|Vodka: ...|Vodka: Ugyaaaaah!

Vodka: Ow, ow, ow... Been a while since I've gotten this sore... Talk about lame...|Vodka: Yesterday I found a car that had run into the ditch. These aches and pains are from dragging it back onto the road.|Vodka: The old lady driving was fine, and I managed to get the tires too, but...|Vodka: I don't know, the fact that something so small wore me out is so uncool...

Vodka: Hehe, I've started collecting five-hundred-yen coins. I'm saving up for a motorcycle.|Vodka: Still don't know which one I want though. They're all so damn cool.|Vodka: Something American would be sweet as hell, but soaring down the roads in a liter bike sounds great too.|Vodka: Hnnngh, I can't wait! I'll take you for a ride when I finally get one!

Vodka: Huh? Scarlet, you've got some rice stuck to your clothes.|Daiwa Scarlet: N-not so loud... I've got an image to protect!|Vodka: Oh, calm down, will ya? Just hurry up and clean yourself up, Miss Smarty Pants.|Daiwa Scarlet: Wh-where is it?!|Vodka: On the hem of your skirt. In the back. Do it now while there's no one looking.|Daiwa Scarlet: The back? Huh? Wh-where?|Vodka: Oh, for—man, you're annoying. Just turn your butt around. I'll grab it for you.|Daiwa Scarlet: Y-you don't have any sense of delicacy, do you?!

Vodka: Opera O! I thought of a cool one-liner! Couldja give it a listen for me?!|Vodka: I spent all night thinking it up, so I'm sure it's a masterpiece!|T.M. Opera O: Haaa-ha-ha-ha-ha! All right, show me the depth of your abyss!|Vodka: I am the Ultimate Supernova of the Racecourse! Pull my trigger and watch me fly... Bam!|T.M. Opera O: Well, well, well! Not bad!|Vodka: Really?! Truly?!|T.M. Opera O: I could feel the radical nature of your nightmare. The rich vibrations of your supernova echoed endlessly into the night!|Vodka: Ohhh... How'd you make it even cooler?!

Daiwa Scarlet: Once I've finished helping the teacher, I believe that one classmate wanted to talk to me... After that, I need to prep for my lessons.|Daiwa Scarlet: I'm cutting it close schedule-wise, but it should be fine!|Daiwa Scarlet: Besides, it feels nice to have so many people depending on me.|Daiwa Scarlet: All right, let's go!

Daiwa Scarlet: Tracen Academy may be big, but I've never gotten lost.|Daiwa Scarlet: Why would I? I already had the map from the campus pamphlets memorized long before I even started here.|Daiwa Scarlet: And now, whenever someone asks me for directions, I can give them calmly and promptly. ♪|Daiwa Scarlet: Got that? If you're going to be my trainer, you'd better have this place memorized as well!

Daiwa Scarlet: We have a lot of events here at Tracen, so it's important to keep up with the postings on the bulletin board.|Daiwa Scarlet: Obviously different competitive events are listed, but they'll add information about recreational events too.|Daiwa Scarlet: If any of them catch your eye, it might make for a nice change of pace—|Daiwa Scarlet: Ah! D-don't get it twisted! I'm not saying I want to go with you, got it?!

Vodka: Yup, no doubt about it. The best Umamusume are the cool ones!|Daiwa Scarlet: What nonsense. Obviously cuteness trumps coolness any day of the week!|Vodka: What?! Are you crazy?!|Vodka: What about that movie? "Three Furlongs of the Heart," right? You were going on and on about how cool the male lead was!|Daiwa Scarlet: Well, what about you?! You said the heroine was so cute, you just had to cheer her on!|Vodka: ...You know what, let's just leave it at that.|Daiwa Scarlet: ...Th-that's my line.

Daiwa Scarlet: Tachyon, thank you again for the supplements!|Agnes Tachyon: Ah, right. Well? Did they help your eye fatigue?|Daiwa Scarlet: Yes! By the next day, I was able to read the book I'd been dying to finish.|Agnes Tachyon: Oh? Any other changes? Any muscle spasms, increased blood circulation, or fits of ecstasy?|Daiwa Scarlet: No, not at all! I actually felt more relaxed than normal. It was like all my stress just disappeared...|Daiwa Scarlet: Just what is in those supplements? I'm sure it took a long time to come up with the current formula.|Agnes Tachyon: Hm? Ah, no, those supplements were created for a previous body modification experiment of mine, so—|Daiwa Scarlet: Training is already so stressful on its own. I can't believe you're also studying medicine on the side!|Daiwa Scarlet: Do you have any tips for efficient studying? I'd love to hear them if you do!|Agnes Tachyon: Oh... What an intriguing response. Heh... You're quite the dangerous one, if I do say so myself.|Daiwa Scarlet: ...?

Taiki Shuttle: Mrgh... The teachers just don't get it. Parties make people happy—they're exciting! "Disturbance," my foot...|Taiki Shuttle: Snacks, games, music! It just ain't a party if all my friends aren't there!|Taiki Shuttle: If I can't have one in the courtyard... I know! I'll hold one near the dorms! I'm sure Hishiama'll give me the okay!|Taiki Shuttle: I just need confetti-filled balloons, a bubble machine... and 'course, a big ol' barbeque! Hehe, I can't wait!

Taiki Shuttle: Uh-oh! Trainer, ya wouldn't happen to be feelin' under the weather, would ya?|Taiki Shuttle: Now, now, none of that! There ain't no foolin' my eyes!|Taiki Shuttle: Okay, that settles it! Today's training will feature Taiki's Special Happy Course!|Taiki Shuttle: The EXTRA happy version! I need to grab me 'bout five hundred party crackers!|Taiki Shuttle: Don't worry! We'll turn that frown upside down! Just you wait!

Taiki Shuttle: Mama's package should get here any day now! It'll have snacks, milk...|Taiki Shuttle: Oh, and pictures of the dogs! I can't wait to see such a big part of our farm's family again!|Taiki Shuttle: They're all such good dogs too... I miss their sloppy kisses somethin' fierce.|Taiki Shuttle: I hope you get to meet 'em someday too, Trainer!|Taiki Shuttle: I'm sure they'll shower you in love and kisses! You're my trainer, after all!

Taiki Shuttle: Hmmm... Hmmm...|Air Groove: Hey, stop that at once! Why do you keep staring at me?!|Taiki Shuttle: I see the problem! Yer not smilin' enough, Air Groove!|Air Groove: ...What?|Taiki Shuttle: C'mon, smile! Ain't there a Japanese sayin' about fortune coming to the laughin' mates?|Air Groove: That's not quite correct. Try again.|Taiki Shuttle: Sure thing! Fortune comes to the dancin' plates!|Air Groove: That's even worse!

Taiki Shuttle: Hey there, Pearl! What's up?|Seeking the Pearl: What's up? Hm... Oh! Yes, I'm dancing!|Taiki Shuttle: Ohhh! Very nice! Let's hang out tonight!|Seeking the Pearl: Hang? Haha! Let's have a gorgeous night!|Taiki Shuttle: Oh, yes! Awesome! I can't wait!|Seeking the Pearl: Heh... I see you understand the universal language!
Grass Wonder: Oh my, Trainer... Your hair's sticking straight up.|Grass Wonder: ...Hehe. It almost reminds me of an Umamusume's ears.|Grass Wonder: I suppose that means we match today. Hehe. ♪

Grass Wonder: ...Hehe. ♪|Grass Wonder: I was looking at my terrarium this morning, and I noticed the moss had sprouted flowers.|Grass Wonder: Just like a real forest, every day brings new, small changes...|Grass Wonder: But there's something about flowers that just sparks joy, isn't there?|Grass Wonder: It truly makes you realize that there's a little world down there, living and changing.|Grass Wonder: If you ever wish to give terrariums a try, I highly recommend it. ♪

Grass Wonder: Hehe, the matcha I received recently has the most lovely scent.|Grass Wonder: Perhaps I'll have some tea today.|Grass Wonder: I should still have some leftover treats from my mother that are perfect for tea...|Grass Wonder: Mhm... Hehe, I can't wait to get back.

El Condor Pasa: Gagh, dang! I forgot all about our homework!|Grass Wonder: Oh my, is everything all right?|El Condor Pasa: This is it... It's do or die! Grass, I need a favor—|Grass Wonder: You know I can't let you copy my homework, El...|El Condor Pasa: Nngh?!|Grass Wonder: There's no point to homework if you don't do it yourself...|Grass Wonder: I'm sure you can do it if you try. I'll be cheering you on!|El Condor Pasa: H-how did you know...
